summary: DriverKit framework for writing user-space drivers for custom PCI and PCI Express hardware, installed through System Extensions (macOS 11.1). BifrOSt drivers are Linux kernel drivers and the shell has no DriverKit-style driver SDK, so there is no counterpart for apps.

features.note: DriverKit entitlement; BifrOSt has no driver entitlements
config and memory access for a custom driver; Linux kernel drivers use their own bus API

features.apple: kIOPCIExpressDeviceCapabilitiesKey, kIOPCIMSIMessageControlKey and the other kIOPCI* macros
features.note: IORegistry capability constants for the DriverKit provider

features.apple: Creating Custom PCIe Drivers for Thunderbolt Devices
features.note: System Extensions install path; no BifrOSt equivalent

features.apple: DriverKit sample code, Connecting a network driver
